what would it sell for

buyers stating they cannot procure it

families.label: Shared infrastructure

who absorbs the fixed cost in a thin season

material_coefficient.why: two cents of a commodity per dollar of an industry's output. Below that, a delivered-price advantage on the commodity cannot move the industry's cost structure enough for the question to be worth the validation cost.

series_break.why: a 60% year-on-year change in a component of a county series. This repository has found a reporting cause behind a large series movement three times, so the screen exists to raise the question and never to answer it.

concentration_employees_per_establishmen.why: a hundred employees per establishment in a detailed industry. It is a screen for structural concentration and says nothing about ownership, which CBP does not publish.

scale_small_usd.why: twenty-five million dollars of annual measured output for a whole productive system in a county. Below it, an intervention with a capital cost in the millions is being proposed against a system whose entire gross receipts are a small multiple of it.

not_an_opportunity.PRODUCTION_SERIES_BREAK: a movement in a measured series is a question about its cause. Until the cause is known it supports no development mechanism, and this repository has three times found the cause to be reporting rather than economics.
not_an_opportunity.SCALE_MISMATCH: a system whose whole output is small is COUNTEREVIDENCE against capital intervention in it, not a reason for one. It is carried so that it can be set against candidates in that system.
not_an_opportunity.EVIDENCE_GAP: a system Dula cannot see is a gap in Dula. The action is acquisition or reading what is already held, not development.

the_comparison.what_it_is_not: a ratio worth computing. Gross farm receipts and a downstream wage bill are not comparable magnitudes: one is revenue, the other is a cost, and the revenue of the downstream firms is not held at all.

the_comparison.r322_overreached: R3.22 reported these as a multiple and used it to argue about where the binding question lies. The scale observation survives; the ratio and the argument built on it do not.

where_the_binding_question_is.scale_is_a_constraint_on_some_things_onl: $18,489,000 of gross farm receipts across 591 operations — $31,284 each — constrains any intervention whose economics depend on throughput. It does not constrain every intervention, and R3.22 came close to reading it that way.

where_the_binding_question_is.and_therefore: the next measurements are production-side -- yield, crop mix, realised price -- because they are the ones nothing currently holds. cross_system.water: irrigation is the link. 6,742 irrigated acres are recorded against 494,844 operated, so 1.4% of the farmland in this county is irrigated and the rest is rangeland. These are two different water systems and Dula holds one of them.

concrete_correction.the_subtraction_is_not_a_shortage: MODELLED DEMAND MINUS MODELLED OUTPUT IS NOT A VERIFIED SHORTAGE, and nothing here reports it as one. Both sides are estimates built from national ratios applied to local payroll, neither has an established error direction, and the local plants may be selling out of the county while the local builders buy in. R3.22 said the direction of the gap flips between resolutions; the right reading of that is that THE COMPARISON IS TOO FRAGILE TO ESTABLISH A GAP IN EITHER DIRECTION -- not that a gap was found at the finer one.
what_now_stands: Existing production CHALLENGES the hypothesis that local productive capability is absent. That part of R3.21 holds and is unchanged.
It does NOT establish market saturation, and R3.21 came close to reading it that way. Eight ready-mix plants is not evidence that the market is served.
The two model-dependent aggregates establish NEITHER actual local purchases NOR supplier market share, and a comparison between them was too fragile to carry the determination it carried.

Expansion, specialisation, supplier development and coordinated procurement all remain open. Only formation of a new plant is argued against, and that by the presence of incumbents rather than by any measure of the market.
NO SHORTAGE AND NO SATURATION IS ESTABLISHED. Neither word is supported by a comparison of two model-dependent estimates, and both are refused.
concrete_correction.determination_now: NOT_ESTABLISHED, for every mechanism. R3.22 moved this to PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED on the strength of the finer resolution; R3.23 withdraws that too, because the finer comparison is between two estimates of the same fragile kind. What IS established is the existence of local productive capability, and nothing beyond it.

the_position: Two places scanned, 54 conditions read out of the holdings, 44 candidates across 8 productive systems — and not one of them chosen in advance. 10 conditions were deliberately NOT promoted, including the two that look most like opportunities: a housing series that collapsed and a food system small enough that the intervention usually proposed for it is argued against by its own size. Santa Fe's water is known system by system and unknown capacity by capacity, so every water-enabled hypothesis is a dependency wearing a constraint's clothes. And the detail input-output table that was on disk the whole time shows R3.21's concrete determination rested on an aggregate that does not survive it.
